description: Choose the meat, the weight and the sides of a grill (mangal) dish.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A grill (mangal) dish builder: the meat as picture cards in a radio group, the weight as chips, the sides as
  checkboxes with prices, then a summary with the live total and the order button. Axes: layout (split,
  stacked), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";
  import type { DishOption } from "../components/option-chips.types";

  export type GrillBuilderProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    meats: DishOption[];
    weights: DishOption[];
    sides: DishOption[];
    total: number;
    currency: string;
    layout?: "split" | "stacked";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import MeatCards from "../components/meat-cards.svelte";
  import OptionChips from "../components/option-chips.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import SideChecks from "../components/side-checks.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    labels,
    meats,
    weights,
    sides,
    total,
    currency,
    layout = "split",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: GrillBuilderProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3">
    <Box
      class={
        (layout as string) === "split" ? "flex flex-col gap-8 lg:col-span-2"
        : "flex flex-col gap-8 lg:col-span-3"
      }
      data-testid="steps"
    >
      <MeatCards name={tpl("{0}-meat", id)} legend={labels.meat} options={meats} />
      <OptionChips name={tpl("{0}-weight", id)} legend={labels.weight} options={weights} extra="note" />
      <SideChecks name={tpl("{0}-sides", id)} legend={labels.sides} options={sides} />
    </Box>
    <Stack
      gap="4"
      class={
        (layout as string) === "split" ? "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-4 p-6 lg:sticky lg:top-8"
        : "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-4 p-6"
      }
      data-testid="summary"
    >
      <Text size="lg" weight="semibold">
        {labels.summary}
      </Text>
      <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {labels.total}
        </Text>
        <Inline class="text-2xl font-bold" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-testid="total">
          {fmtMoney(total, currency)}
        </Inline>
      </Group>
      <Button variant="default" size="lg" type="button" class="w-full">
        <LucideIcon name="shopping-bag" size={16} />
        {labels.add}
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  </Box>
</SectionFrame>
